Switzerland & Italy · Family trip

1 · The journey

David and Michelle traveled with her parents, using Luzern as home base except for three nights around Como.

2 · Every leg matters

Travel legs appear in their planned or recorded order. Open any day to isolate its route.

3 · Plans can grow

Days can start with a few notes. Destinations, routes, and photographs can be added as the journey takes shape.

4 · Photos follow the day

The full-screen viewer keeps each day's photographs together. Day controls move the route map and journal context with the images.
